summary: Hesai Group filed a Form 6-K reporting poll results of an extraordinary general meeting held August 28, 2026. The resolution proposed was passed as an ordinary resolution. Detailed vote counts and abstentions were disclosed, including shares held by co-founders and treasury share considerations. No special-situation event such as an acquisition, tender offer, or restructuring is involved; this is a routine corporate governance disclosure. The filing confirms shareholder approval of an unspecified agenda item, with no deal terms or strategic actions announced.
